steps: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 2 of the defender.
|!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Throw the defender |!movement_small|.
|!critical| |!wild| |*Explosive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: I‘m Just Getting Warmed Up
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or enemy character, both of Size 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Ready or Not . . .
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.
